items.statement: The reported structure is the supplied charge -4 sextet Fe(III)Cl@TCPP model and the optimization is checked for minimum character or a clearly documented bounded failure.
items.expected: Charge -4 and multiplicity 6 are retained; minimum verification and diagnostics are reported.

items.statement: Every predicted shift is tied to an explicit nucleus/site identity and equivalent-site averaging is documented.
items.expected: Three 1H sites and eight 13C sites are individually identified with atom mapping.

items.statement: The calculated site shifts reproduce the observed Fe@PCN-224 ligand-shift pattern with strong separate 1H and 13C agreement.
items.expected: Predictions preserve the reported assignments and yield high correlation for both nuclei; exact values are compared by evaluator from the paper reference.

items.statement: The optimized local Fe coordination distances are compatible with the diffraction coordination boundary.
items.expected: Four Fe--N distances and one Fe--Cl distance are reported and compared with the experimental coordination distances.
